name: hpe
description: A modular, AI-friendly HTML presentation engine

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && node scripts/run-deck.mjs build
scripts.build:example: npm run build:packages && node scripts/run-deck.mjs build --deck-root tests/fixtures/e2e-deck
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b && npm run assets -w @hpe/schema && npm run bin:chmod -w @hpe/cli
scripts.boundaries: dependency-cruiser packages/*/src app/src app/slides app/themes presentations/hello-hpe/slides presentations/hello-hpe/themes tests/fixtures/*/slides tests/fixtures/*/themes --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.clean: rimraf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo app/dist app/*.tsbuildinfo coverage artifacts
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && node scripts/run-deck.mjs dev
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && npm run typecheck -w @hpe/app
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:packages && npm run test:bundle && npm run test:isolation && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:licenses && npm audit
